rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun construction for a person's general lack of honesty.

example.english: Everyone knew about Ah Ming's dishonesty long ago.
example.traditional: 阿明嘅唔老實，大家一早就知。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 ge3 m4 lou5 sat6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 zou2 zau6 zi1

rows.jyutping: m4 lou5 sat6 ge3 haang4 wai4
rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for a particular dishonest act when you do not mean specifically fraud.

example.english: Changing the report behind my back was really an act of dishonesty.
example.traditional: 佢瞞住我改咗份報告，真係唔老實嘅行為。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mun4 zyu6 ngo5 goi2 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 m4 lou5 sat6 ge3 haang4 wai4

rows.note: Use this formal term when the dishonest act specifically involves fraud or deception.

example.english: The company was taken to court over dishonesty involving fraud.
example.traditional: 間公司因為欺詐行為，被人告上法庭。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 hei1 zaa3 haang4 wai4 bei6 jan4 gou3 soeng5 faat3 ting4
